info.name: FinancialEventCollector — Azure (Deployed)
info.description:
Postman collection targeting the deployed Azure App Service at https://financialeventcollector-bzf0e4htg8d7ecfr.westus2-01.azurewebsites.net/

Organised by controller:
- **Admin** (role: admin) — runtime configuration snapshot
- **Event** (role: user) — lineage, logs, prompt, and AI investigation per event scenario
- **Incident** (role: user) — incident listing, prompt, and AI investigation per incident scenario
- **Telemetry** (role: user) — recent investigation telemetry
- **Validation** (role: admin) — full scenario validation run

### Authentication
The `X-Api-Key` header is set **once** at the collection level via the `auth` block and is automatically inherited by every request. The value is driven by the `apiKey` collection variable (default: `AdminSecret`), which grants both `admin` and `user` roles — giving access to all endpoints.

To change the key, edit the `apiKey` collection variable in Postman (Collection → Variables tab).

variable.description: Root URL of the deployed Azure App Service
API key sent as X-Api-Key header on every request. AdminSecret grants both admin and user roles.

item.name: Admin (role: admin)
item.description: Admin-only configuration endpoints. Requires the admin API key.

request.description:
Returns a full snapshot of the current runtime configuration.

Includes:
- Environment name and application version
- LLM settings (model, max tokens, API base URL — API key is redacted)
- Cache settings (enabled flag, TTL in hours)
- Complete RootCause enum catalog with descriptions

**Auth:** admin

item.name: Event (role: user)
item.description:
Event lineage and AI investigation endpoints. Organised by the 6 test scenarios stored in data/EventLogs.json.

Scenario → EventId mapping:
| Scenario | EventId |
|---|---|
| AllAuditEventsPresent | evt-001 |
| MissingIngestionAuditEvent | evt-002 |
| MissingIndexingAuditEvent | evt-003 |
| MissingPublishingAuditEvent | evt-004 |
| PublishLatencyExceedsSLA | evt-005 |
| UnknownRootCause | evt-006 |

item.name: Scenario 1 — AllAuditEventsPresent (evt-001)
item.description: Healthy baseline: all three pipeline stages (Ingest, Index, Publish) completed successfully within normal timing. No gap expected.

request.description:
Returns the data lineage projection for evt-001 (AllAuditEventsPresent).

Expected: ingestSuccess=true, indexSuccess=true, publishSuccess=true, missingAuditEvents=[], publishLatencySlaMet=true

Returns the raw audit events and worker logs for evt-001.

Expected: 3 EventTelemetry audit events (Ingest, Index, Publish), no worker logs.

Returns the fully-assembled LLM investigation prompt for evt-001 without invoking the LLM.

Useful for debugging and auditing what data is sent to Claude.

Runs an AI-powered investigation for evt-001 (AllAuditEventsPresent).

Expected verdict: rootCause=AllAuditEventsPresent
Check the X-Cache response header: HIT = served from cache, MISS = fresh LLM call.

Rate limit: 10 LLM calls/minute per IP.

item.name: Scenario 2 — MissingIngestionAuditEvent (evt-002)
item.description: No IngestAuditEvent recorded. The IngestionWorker logged a ConnectionDropException before the payload could be read. Ingest gates both Index and Publish — the event never entered the pipeline.

request.description:
Returns the data lineage projection for evt-002 (MissingIngestionAuditEvent).

Expected: ingestSuccess=false, indexSuccess=false, publishSuccess=false, missingAuditEvents=[IngestAuditEvent]

Returns the raw audit events and worker logs for evt-002.

Expected: 1 ExceptionTelemetry audit event (IngestAuditEvent with ConnectionDropException), 3 worker log entries.
Returns the fully-assembled LLM investigation prompt for evt-002 without invoking the LLM.

Runs an AI-powered investigation for evt-002 (MissingIngestionAuditEvent).

Expected verdict: rootCause=MissingIngestionAuditEvent
Check the X-Cache response header: HIT = served from cache, MISS = fresh LLM call.

item.name: Scenario 3 — MissingIndexingAuditEvent (evt-003)
item.description: Ingest and Publish are present, but the IndexAuditEvent is missing. The IndexingWorker logged an IndexStoreTimeoutException. Index and Publish run as independent parallel workers — Publish can complete even if Indexing fails.

request.description:
Returns the data lineage projection for evt-003 (MissingIndexingAuditEvent).

Expected: ingestSuccess=true, indexSuccess=false, publishSuccess=true, missingAuditEvents=[IndexAuditEvent]

Returns the raw audit events and worker logs for evt-003.

Expected: 3 audit events (Ingest=EventTelemetry, Index=ExceptionTelemetry with IndexStoreTimeoutException, Publish=EventTelemetry), 1 IndexingWorker error log.
Returns the fully-assembled LLM investigation prompt for evt-003 without invoking the LLM.

Runs an AI-powered investigation for evt-003 (MissingIndexingAuditEvent).

Expected verdict: rootCause=MissingIndexingAuditEvent
Check the X-Cache response header: HIT = served from cache, MISS = fresh LLM call.

item.name: Scenario 4 — MissingPublishingAuditEvent (evt-004)
item.description: Ingest and Index are present, but the PublishAuditEvent is missing. The PublishingWorker exceeded the connection retry limit to EventHub — the event was fully processed internally but never reached downstream consumers.

request.description:
Returns the data lineage projection for evt-004 (MissingPublishingAuditEvent).

Expected: ingestSuccess=true, indexSuccess=true, publishSuccess=false, missingAuditEvents=[PublishAuditEvent]

Returns the raw audit events and worker logs for evt-004.

Expected: 3 audit events (Ingest=EventTelemetry, Index=EventTelemetry, Publish=ExceptionTelemetry with EventHubConnectionException), 1 PublishingWorker error log.
Returns the fully-assembled LLM investigation prompt for evt-004 without invoking the LLM.

Runs an AI-powered investigation for evt-004 (MissingPublishingAuditEvent).

Expected verdict: rootCause=MissingPublishingAuditEvent
Check the X-Cache response header: HIT = served from cache, MISS = fresh LLM call.

item.name: Scenario 5 — PublishLatencyExceedsSLA (evt-005)
item.description: All three audit events are present but the Ingest-to-Publish gap is ~17.1 minutes, exceeding the 15-minute SLA threshold. The PublishingWorker experienced transient EventHub throttling and retried successfully, but the cumulative delay breached SLA. No data loss occurred.

request.description:
Returns the data lineage projection for evt-005 (PublishLatencyExceedsSLA).

Expected: ingestSuccess=true, indexSuccess=true, publishSuccess=true, missingAuditEvents=[], publishLatencySlaMet=false (latency ~17.1 min > 15 min SLA)

Returns the raw audit events and worker logs for evt-005.

Expected: 3 EventTelemetry audit events, 5 PublishingWorker log entries (4 throttle warnings + 1 success after 4 retries).
Returns the fully-assembled LLM investigation prompt for evt-005 without invoking the LLM.

Runs an AI-powered investigation for evt-005 (PublishLatencyExceedsSLA).

Expected verdict: rootCause=PublishLatencyExceedsSLA
Check the X-Cache response header: HIT = served from cache, MISS = fresh LLM call.

item.name: Scenario 6 — UnknownRootCause (evt-006)
item.description: No audit events recorded at all. The only worker log is a generic IngestionWorker restart warning with no eventId and no actionable context. Evidence is entirely absent — root cause is genuinely indeterminate.

request.description:
Returns the data lineage projection for evt-006 (UnknownRootCause).

Expected: ingestSuccess=false, indexSuccess=false, publishSuccess=false, missingAuditEvents=[IngestAuditEvent, IndexAuditEvent, PublishAuditEvent]

Returns the raw audit events and worker logs for evt-006.

Expected: 0 audit events, 1 IngestionWorker warning log (generic restart, no context).
Returns the fully-assembled LLM investigation prompt for evt-006 without invoking the LLM.

Runs an AI-powered investigation for evt-006 (UnknownRootCause).

Expected verdict: rootCause=Unknown
Check the X-Cache response header: HIT = served from cache, MISS = fresh LLM call.

item.name: Telemetry (role: user)
item.description: In-memory telemetry store endpoints. Returns investigation telemetry events emitted by both the Event and Incident investigation endpoints.

query.description: Maximum number of events to return (1–100, default 10)

request.description:
Returns the most recent investigation telemetry events in ascending chronological order.

Each entry includes: telemetryType, timestamp, incidentId (null for event-driven investigations), eventId, response (responseTimeMs, cached, confidence, rootCause, llmUsage), and validation (expectedRootCause, actualRootCause, rootCauseMatch).

query.description: Maximum number of events to return (1–100)

request.description: Returns up to 50 recent investigation telemetry events. Useful after running multiple investigations to review the full history.

item.name: Validation (role: admin)
item.description:
Runs every incident scenario through the investigation pipeline and compares the LLM verdict against the human-authored ground-truth label (ExpectedRootCause). Useful for regression testing the LLM prompt and measuring overall accuracy and cost.

Note: The cache is bypassed — every incident is always sent directly to the LLM.

query.description: Number of incidents to process (1–10). 6 = all scenarios.

request.description:
Executes the investigation pipeline for all 6 incident scenarios and returns:
- Per-incident comparison of expected vs. actual root cause
- rootCauseMatch boolean for each incident
- Aggregated LLM cost across all non-cached calls

Rate limit: 10 LLM calls/minute per IP. Running all 6 scenarios counts as 6 calls.
